verdict.rationale: stagewise is itself an agentic IDE that hosts coding agents, so it sits in the MCP client role. Its plugins (GitHub, Supabase, Figma) are client-side integrations, not evidence that stagewise runs as an MCP server. Nothing in the pack documents a server mode, such as an 'mcp serve' command or a hosted MCP endpoint, so the server axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
